Recorded claim:
A timeout after all assertions pass, many unrelated `child process hang at shutdown` crashes on the same worker, and an identical successful retrigger strongly support bad-worker/infrastructure failure. For `test_unregister_invalid_json.js`, Bug 1781451's intended synchronization (`await PushService.init(...)` before `PushService.unregister(...)`) was already present; focused repeat-5 and the full Push suite passed locally.
